title: Estate of Margaret Lee
kind: an inheritance among three adult siblings
will: My watercolor painting of the lake house goes to my daughter Cara. Everything else is to be divided equally among my three children.
notes: The house is being sold separately and its proceeds split equally, so it isn't part of this split.
Every heir owns an equal 1/3 share of every item unless the will says otherwise.

items.name: Diamond engagement ring
items.description: Margaret's 1.2 ct engagement ring, platinum band.

items.name: Coin collection (Dad's)
items.description: Dad's silver dollar and proof-set collection, three albums.

items.name: Watercolor of the lake house
items.description: Original watercolor of the family lake house. Specific bequest to Cara.

items.name: Grandfather clock

reasons.ring: Mom wore it every day; I want to wear it at my wedding.
reasons.piano: Mom taught me to play on this piano, and my kids are learning on it now.
reasons.dining: Every Sunday dinner happened at that table.

reasons.coins: Dad and I sorted those coins together every summer.
reasons.piano: I'd love my daughter to keep practicing on Grandma's piano.
reasons.car: My car just died and I need something reliable for the commute.

reasons.ring: She promised it to me when I got engaged.
reasons.coins: Dad started that collection the year I was born.
reasons.painting: I was with her at the lake the summer she painted it.
